tx-i35.name: I-35: San Antonio to Austin, Texas

roosts.name: Bracken Cave Preserve
roosts.note: World's largest bat colony; Bat Conservation International preserve. Emergence March to October, peak July to September.

roosts.name: Congress Avenue Bridge, Austin
roosts.note: Largest urban bat colony in North America. Present late March to early November.

roosts.name: McNeil Road overpass on I-35, Round Rock
roosts.note: A free-tailed colony living in the expansion joints of I-35 itself.

roosts.name: Camden Street Bridge, San Antonio
roosts.note: Urban free-tailed colony over the San Antonio River.

ky-i65.name: I-65: Louisville to Bowling Green, Kentucky

roosts.name: Mammoth Cave National Park
roosts.note: Historic hibernaculum for Indiana, gray, and little brown bats; a karst landscape bisected by I-65.

roosts.name: Hidden River Cave, Horse Cave
roosts.note: Gray bat maternity and bachelor colony beneath the town of Horse Cave, one mile from I-65.

roosts.name: Bernheim Forest
roosts.note: Forest block with documented Indiana and northern long-eared bat summer roosts next to I-65.

nm-us62.name: US 62/180: Carlsbad to Carlsbad Caverns, New Mexico

roosts.name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
roosts.note: Nightly bat flight program April to October; the park is an International Dark Sky Park.
